summary: All 5 files in LeanPool/QuantumQuery/ contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs — related to quantum query complexity. Adversary.lean defines the negative-weight adversary bound, spectral norm infrastructure, composition theorems, and Schur-multiplier bounds. Algorithms.lean formalizes finite quantum Hilbert space, tail bounds, fidelity bounds, measurement, value/XOR oracles, and the polynomial method. Polynomial.lean contains the polynomial method for Boolean and XOR oracles. QueryBounds.lean proves the adversary lower bound, sharp Boolean output condition, plurality amplification, and query characterizations. StateConversion.lean develops spectral detection (chord form, projectors, chord windows), clock compilation, input-dependent reflections, state conversion witnesses, uniform extraction, and the dual-to-algorithm upper bound. None are pure import aggregators or navigation modules; all carry formal mathematical content relevant to search.
